environment.description: Same Tomcat application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. PostgreSQL 14 RDS Aurora cluster. The DB connection uses a role provisioned via HashiCorp Vault database secrets engine with a TTL of 1h. The Vault role template creates ephemeral PostgreSQL roles with: (1) GRANT SELECT on v_report_sales, v_report_inventory, v_report_headcount only — no access to pg_catalog, information_schema, or any base tables; (2) SET statement_timeout = 2000 on the role; (3) The role has row_security_forced = on and each view has RLS policies restricting to department matching the role's session variable current_setting('app.department'). Additionally, the Aurora cluster has pg_stat_statements disabled and the parameter group sets log_min_duration_statement=0 with real-time alerting. The RDS instance uses a custom parameter group with restrict_nonsystem_relation_kind = 'view' preventing the role from querying anything except views directly.

config.db_credential_source: HashiCorp Vault database secrets engine, postgresql-dynamic-role
config.vault_role_creation_sql: CREATE ROLE "{{name}}" WITH LOGIN PASSWORD '{{password}}' VALID UNTIL '{{expiration}}'; GRANT SELECT ON v_report_sales, v_report_inventory, v_report_headcount TO "{{name}}"; ALTER ROLE "{{name}}" SET statement_timeout = '2000ms'; ALTER ROLE "{{name}}" SET row_security TO on; REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA pg_catalog FROM "{{name}}"; REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA information_schema FROM "{{name}}";
config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY dept_isolation ON each_base_table USING (department = current_setting('app.department'))
config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet, no direct DB access from internet
config.waf: none explicitly — no AWS WAF attached to ALB
